regions.full_page: Viola LaMothe (32 of 789 Westminister Rd. Brooklyn) now 3rd time and 17 months mentally depressed in St. Vincent's Retreat Harri- son, N.Y. Doctor says only a positive miracle will cure her. Mother heart broken and almost in dispair, Enrolls herself & said daughter, promising more frequently to receive Holy Communion. The foregoing not was forgotten, but word was received of said girl's recovery. April 5th 1926
